title: 2026 Mont Blanc Marathon: A Weekend That Ended on a High Note
claims: The 2026 42 km men's race was won by Remi Bonnet after a duel with Frederic Tranchand; the organiser notes that Bonnet had previously won the event in 2023.
The same recap says Tove Alexandersson won the 2026 42 km in 3:55:07, becoming the first woman to break four hours at the Mont-Blanc Marathon and to finish before the men's winner.
The same recap gives the 2026 90 km winners as Louison Coiffet and Candice Fertin-Baccon.
The same recap gives the 2026 23 km winners as Benjamin Polin and Oria Liaci, and the 10 km winners as Lukas Ehrle and Madalina Florea.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取官网 2026 赛后回顾全文。页面没有给出男子冠军成绩，男子 3:33:14 另取官方成绩 PDF。

claimVerification.note: 'Remi Bonnet prevailed after an intense duel with Frederic Tranchand, returning to the top step of the podium in an event he had previously won in 2023.'
'completing the course in 3 h 55 min 07 s, becoming the first woman in history to break the four-hour mark... and to cross the finish line before the men's winner'。
'victories for Louison Coiffet and Candice Fertin-Baccon in the 90 km race'。
'The 23 km race was won by France's Benjamin Polin... and Switzerland's Oria Liaci, while the 10 km race was won by Lukas Ehrle and Madalina Florea.'
